\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering\small
\caption{Selected related studies and their connection to the present forecasting problem. The task descriptions refer to the cited studies, not to evidence of twenty-year performance.}\label{tab:literature}
\begin{adjustwidth}{-\extralength}{0cm}
\centering
\begin{tabularx}{\fulllength}{@{}>{\RaggedRight\arraybackslash}p{.19\fulllength}>{\RaggedRight\arraybackslash}p{.21\fulllength}Y@{}}
\toprule
Study & Forecasting task or method & Relevance and distinction \\
\midrule
Carvallo et al.\ \cite{Carvallo2018} & Long-term utility-plan forecasts & Retrospective accuracy of planning forecasts; emphasizes comparison with realized demand.\\
Hong and Lee\ \cite{Hong2025} & Monthly load under growth & Regression and statistical/ML comparisons; a shorter forecasting horizon than the scenarios considered here.\\
Ruales and Jaramillo\ \cite{Ruales2024_SARIMA_EERSA} & Medium-term SARIMA & Network-planning consumption application; a classical comparator, not the present peak target.\\
Jaramillo and Carrión\ \cite{Jaramillo2022_AdaptiveSARIMA} & Adaptive SARIMA & Demand changes during COVID-19; motivates evaluation across changing regimes.\\
Alquthami et al.\ \cite{Alquthami2022_MLComparison} & Machine-learning comparison & Performance depends on the specific data and input representation.\\
Veljanovski et al.\ \cite{Veljanovski2022_RFECV_ANN} & Feature selection and ANN & Short-term feature engineering; no direct validation of a long-horizon structural layer.\\
Hussein et al.\ \cite{Hussein2023_PSO_SVM}; Dai et al.\ \cite{Dai2022_EMD_mRMR_PSO_SVM} & Optimized and hybrid SVM & Model tuning and preprocessing are part of the forecasting procedure.\\
Jin et al.\ \cite{Jin2022_LSTM_BPNN_Peak} & Hybrid peak-load model & Multisource information and limited annual data.\\
Liu et al.\ \cite{Liu2025_CNNGRUReliability} & CNN--GRU reliability forecasting & Medium-/long-term application with a different reliability-oriented formulation.\\
Nafea et al.\ \cite{Nafea2026_HybridDLSpain}; Musbah and Elsaraiti\ \cite{Musbah2025_DLvsML} & Hybrid DL and comparative load forecasting & Context for temporal inputs and comparisons among learning methods.\\
Lim et al.\ \cite{Lim2021} & TFT & Covariate-aware forecasting architecture; used recursively here.\\
Wang et al.\ \cite{WangHyndmanLiKang2023}; Wu and Levinson\ \cite{WuLevinson2021} & Forecast combination reviews & Weighting and complementary errors require empirical assessment.\\
Mroueh et al.\ \cite{Mroueh2025_BFTFusion}; Caro and Juan\ \cite{Caro2026_ErrorsCI} & Uncertainty and error analysis & Distinguish distributional evaluation from point-error reporting.\\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\end{adjustwidth}
\end{table}
